modules.name: 探索主模型
modules.model: heading_seed4 (weights unchanged) + detection-scale redundancy penalty (weight 8) + edge-uncertainty direction gate
modules.role: Use visitation memory and persistent subgoals; scores are reduced by the share of the candidate's 220 mm detection swath already covered; after edge contact any direction inward of the uncertain edge fit may be chosen.
modules.limitation: Visits edges about twice as often as before. Penalty weight and gate margins tuned in simulation only; custom maps keep the previous local screening and no penalty.

modules.name: 触黑框后的定位停车控制器
modules.kind: geometric feedback controller, not separate neural weights
modules.role: Fit early when observations suffice, verify direction stripes, scan laterally only when ambiguous, then park and verify settling.
modules.limitation: Current early_fit behaviour retained; unused search modes removed.

modules.name: 触边动作（方向向量）
modules.kind: geometric rule-based escape planner with one tuned parameter (safe_mm=70), not a neural network
inputs: main-model selected heading (kept as a vector; start point may move)
edge fit at contact, grey cells, visited cells, encoders
modules.outputs: Brake; reverse along the visited track (steep contact) or hold the outer wheel and reverse the inner one (grazing contact) until the centre is safe_mm from all edge evidence; spin to the heading; travel along it from the new position. A new edge contact during the manoeuvre aborts it and asks for a fresh decision.
modules.role: Execute the chosen direction after edge contact without spinning next to the edge.
modules.constraints: Exploration weights and early_fit unchanged. No simulator truth enters inference.
modules.policy_use: The 304-byte network is only used by the previous conditional motion, which custom maps still use.
modules.limitation: About 0.25 s wheel excursion per contact remains from braking inertia. Relies on odometry for visited/grey cells. No physical validation.
